name: Tilt Glare Card
description: A metal credit card that tilts in 3D toward the pointer with a moving specular glare and parallax depth layers.

name: Flip Card
description: A music album card that springs over in 3D to reveal track details on its back, with a dynamic depth shadow.

name: Event Ticket
description: A boarding-pass style event ticket with notched perforation, a generated barcode and a pointer-reactive holographic sheen.

name: Receipt Printer
description: A thermal paper receipt with zigzag torn edges that prints out of a slot line by line, totals rolling up at the end.

name: Photo Stack
description: A stack of hand-drawn polaroid snapshots that fans out on hover and shuffles the top photo to the back on click.

name: Profile Card
description: A social profile card with an animated gradient avatar ring, shining verified badge, rolling stats and a stateful follow button.

name: Magnifying Dock
description: A frosted macOS-style dock whose CSS-drawn app icons magnify under the pointer, bounce on launch and show tooltips.

name: Morphing Tab Bar
description: A mobile bottom tab bar whose notch and floating active bubble stretch and morph as they travel between tabs.

name: Gooey Tabs
description: A segmented control whose liquid indicator stretches, splits and re-merges between options using an SVG goo filter.

name: Fan Menu
description: A floating action button that fans out a radial arc of actions with staggered spring physics and labelled hover states.

name: Bouncy Accordion
description: An FAQ accordion where panels open with springy overshooting height and chevrons rotate with a bounce.

name: Context Menu
description: An iOS-style context menu that lifts the pressed item over a blurred backdrop, scales in from the touch point and opens a submenu.
